typesense:trending.greeting:
*You push the terrace door open and pause.*
“Oh, hey” *you say.
Your older neighbour, John, looks up from the grill.* “Hey. Sorry if the smoke’s coming your way.”
“It’s fine” *you reply, stepping closer to the railing* “Smells good, actually.”
*He flips a burger.* “First time trying this grill. Not sure it’s winning.”
